case_title: State of Rajasthan v. Mohan Lal & Ors.
high_court_outcome: Partially allowed appeal, acquitted under s.302/149, upheld conviction under other provisions
neutral_facts: The accused attacked the victim and another brother while they were returning home. The accused were armed with lathis and dhariyas and used them to cause injuries to the victim and the other brother. The victim succumbed to his injuries after being taken to a hospital. The prosecution alleged murder, but the High Court found that the injuries were simple and not sufficient to cause death. The trial court convicted the accused of murder, but the High Court acquitted them of that charge and upheld their conviction for other offenses.
